title: Star-morph wedding invitation
summary: A scroll-driven wedding invitation that uses a four-point star to transition between sections.
brief: Design an invitation for an imaginary couple. Let scrolling reshape a blue star into a note card, then use a star-shaped wipe to reveal the next section. Build the look with lettering and geometry, without photos.

prompts.text: Make a scroll-driven wedding invitation web page for a fictional couple, Mira and Theo. Pale grey-white grain background with soft blurred grey blobs, one electric blue (#0a6cdc) accent, an elegant italic serif for big headings and a clean sans for small labels. The hero is a huge italic "WEDDING" with a thin orbit ring and a small star. As the visitor scrolls, a single four-point star morphs from section to section: an outline star holds "Welcome" and folds into a blue rounded card titled MESSAGE, a white star expands to wipe the card away into ABOUT US, then big blue words scatter around a solid star that shrinks into a dot for OUR STORY. Use no photos or logos, only shapes and type, and no extra titles or labels beyond these. Build it in a new folder inside the current project folder, open it in the browser when it is done, check that it works, and ask me before installing or loading anything.
